<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a primary peak at m/z 134.11 followed by a series of peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart with decreasing intensities (≈11 % for M+1, ≈0.5 % for M+2, etc.)—the pattern matches the natural carbon isotopic distribution (12C → 13C). No other element shows such a multi‑peak, ~1 Da spaced pattern in the spectrum, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
